headline: All candidate windows share the same denominator k
statement: Return the maximum average among all contiguous subarrays of nums having exactly k elements. Answers within 10^-5 are accepted.
intuition: All candidate windows share the same denominator k. Maximize their sum by replacing one outgoing element with one incoming element per step.
approach: Sum the first k values and initialize best to that sum.
Slide the right end through the remaining values.
Add nums[right] and subtract nums[right-k]; update best.
correctness: Initially total equals the first window sum. Each transition removes exactly the value leaving and adds exactly the value entering, preserving the window-sum invariant. Every length-k window is measured once, and maximizing its sum also maximizes its average.
bruteForce: Sum every length-k slice independently: O(n*k) time.

complexity.explanation: Time O(n); auxiliary space O(1). Output storage is excluded unless stated.

pitfalls: Initialize best from a real window so all-negative arrays work.
The length is exactly k, not at most k.
Use floating-point division for the final average.
